name: stuck-detector
description: Notices when the same test command fails twice in a row and tells the model to ask for a second opinion.

note.title: Note to the model
note.description: Added to the result of a test command that has failed twice in a row.
note.default: This test command has failed twice in a row. Stop fixing and ask for a second opinion from three subagents side by side on the same brief, with the same models and effort as the pre-PR review: second-opinion on Fable 5.1, second-opinion-sonnet on Sonnet 5.5 and second-opinion-haiku on Haiku 5.5, all at high effort. Brief them with the symptom, what you tried, what each attempt showed, and the files to read first.
